prompts.doryuuheki: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART effect spritesheet for Vila Ninja, top-down oblique isometric anime ninja RPG, hand-pixeled JRPG style, deliberate hard pixel clusters, limited earthy palette, readable at 32-48 pixels in game. EXACTLY EIGHT frames in STRICT FOUR COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS, equal square cells, landscape 2:1 canvas, reading left-to-right then next row. True alpha transparent PNG. No characters, no hands, no text, no labels, no grid, no checkerboard, no scenery, no floor tile, no outline rectangle. EACH complete frame must fit within x18..82%, y18..82% of its OWN cell, with LARGE EMPTY transparent gutters. No clipping, no neighboring frames touching. Same camera, same registration in all frames. Subject Doton Doryuuheki earth wall. An upright thick rectangular slab of compacted EARTH rising from soil, rough mud-brown surface with large irregular cracks and layered earthen ridges, chipped ragged top, subtly visible top thickness, not brick masonry or castle, no carvings. Front wall face toward viewer, base edge HORIZONTAL so code can shear it to the isometric ground angle later. Aspect of full wall roughly width:height 1.5:1. Same ground anchor x50%,y78% every frame. Eight ONE-SHOT PHASES:1 low dirt ridge and few stones,2 wall one-third height,3 wall two-thirds height,4 full standing wall,5 same full wall stable,6 cracks widening as top crumbles,7 half wall collapsing into rubble,8 low settling rubble. Fixed common scale preserves growth, wall never moves horizontally. Warm ochre highlights, medium earthy brown main face, dark brown fissures. Small clean dust clusters near base only, no diffuse smoke.
